question: How many students live in China?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "students_attributes" AS SELECT "stuid" AS "stuid", "student_id" AS "student_id", "attribute_value" AS "attribute_value" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "cities_reference" AS SELECT "city_code" AS "city_code", "city_name" AS "city_name", "latitude" AS "latitude", "longitude" AS "longitude", "state_country" AS "state_country" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH student_city AS (
  SELECT LOWER(stuid) AS key, student_id, attribute_value AS city_code
  FROM students_attributes
  WHERE stuid IS NOT NULL AND attribute_value IS NOT NULL
), city_attr AS (
  SELECT student_id, city_code
  FROM student_city
  WHERE key = 'city'
), city_parsed AS (
  SELECT 
    c.city_code,
    c.city_name,
    c.state_country,
    -- parse country token after delimiter '~' if present
    CASE 
      WHEN instr(state_country, '~') > 0 THEN split_part(state_country, '~', 2)
      ELSE state_country
    END AS country_code
  FROM cities_reference c
), china_students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.student_id
  FROM city_attr ca
  JOIN city_parsed cp ON ca.city_code = cp.city_code
  WHERE UPPER(cp.country_code) IN ('CN','CHN','CHINA')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS students_living_in_china
FROM china_students;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH attrs AS (
  SELECT LOWER(COALESCE(stuid, '')) AS key, TRIM(CAST(attribute_value AS VARCHAR)) AS val, CAST(student_id AS VARCHAR) AS student_id
  FROM students_attributes
  WHERE student_id IS NOT NULL AND attribute_value IS NOT NULL
),
country_attr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT student_id
  FROM attrs
  WHERE key IN ('country','nation')
    AND UPPER(val) IN ('CN','CHN','CHINA','PEOPLES REPUBLIC OF CHINA','P. R. CHINA')
),
city_keys AS (
  SELECT student_id, val AS raw_city
  FROM attrs
  WHERE key IN ('city','homecity','city_code','cityname','hometown','residence_city')
),
city_ref AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(city_code) AS city_code,
    TRIM(city_name) AS city_name,
    CASE WHEN instr(state_country, '~') > 0 THEN split_part(state_country, '~', 2) ELSE state_country END AS country_code
  FROM cities_reference
),
-- Try join by exact code match
by_code AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ck.student_id
  FROM city_keys ck
  JOIN city_ref cr ON UPPER(ck.raw_city) = UPPER(cr.city_code)
  WHERE UPPER(cr.country_code) IN ('CN','CHN','CHINA')
),
-- If not code, try join by city name
by_name AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ck.student_id
  FROM city_keys ck
  JOIN city_ref cr ON UPPER(ck.raw_city) = UPPER(cr.city_name)
  WHERE UPPER(cr.country_code) IN ('CN','CHN','CHINA')
),
china_students AS (
  SELECT student_id FROM country_attr
  UNION
  SELECT student_id FROM by_code
  UNION
  SELECT student_id FROM by_name
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS students_living_in_china
FROM china_students;

# Broaden logic:
# - Accept city key variants: 'city', 'homecity', 'city_code', 'cityname'.
# - If city value looks like a known city_code, join on code; else try joining by city_name.
# - Also accept a direct 'country' attribute (CN/CHN/China) without city.
# - Case-insensitive comparisons; dedupe students.

query = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH attrs AS (
  SELECT LOWER(COALESCE(stuid, '')) AS key, TRIM(CAST(attribute_value AS VARCHAR)) AS val, CAST(student_id AS VARCHAR) AS student_id
  FROM students_attributes
  WHERE student_id IS NOT NULL AND attribute_value IS NOT NULL
),
country_attr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT student_id
  FROM attrs
  WHERE key IN ('country','nation')
    AND UPPER(val) IN ('CN','CHN','CHINA','PEOPLES REPUBLIC OF CHINA','P. R. CHINA')
),
city_keys AS (
  SELECT student_id, val AS raw_city
  FROM attrs
  WHERE key IN ('city','homecity','city_code','cityname','hometown','residence_city')
),
city_ref AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(city_code) AS city_code,
    TRIM(city_name) AS city_name,
    CASE WHEN instr(state_country, '~') > 0 THEN split_part(state_country, '~', 2) ELSE state_country END AS country_code
  FROM cities_reference
),
-- Try join by exact code match
by_code AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ck.student_id
  FROM city_keys ck
  JOIN city_ref cr ON UPPER(ck.raw_city) = UPPER(cr.city_code)
  WHERE UPPER(cr.country_code) IN ('CN','CHN','CHINA')
),
-- If not code, try join by city name
by_name AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ck.student_id
  FROM city_keys ck
  JOIN city_ref cr ON UPPER(ck.raw_city) = UPPER(cr.city_name)
  WHERE UPPER(cr.country_code) IN ('CN','CHN','CHINA')
),
china_students AS (
  SELECT student_id FROM country_attr
  UNION
  SELECT student_id FROM by_code
  UNION
  SELECT student_id FROM by_name
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS students_living_in_china
FROM china_students;
'''
